# Camo Trucker Hats

Camo trucker hats are trucker-style caps that carry a camouflage print on the crown, the bill, or the back panels. wholesalehats.com distributes camo trucker options from several brands for bulk orders.

## What are camo trucker hats and what are they best for?

The identifying feature of this variant is the camouflage pattern itself, applied to at least one part of the cap.

- **Hunting and outdoor retailers:** camouflage prints match the products these stores sell.
- **Outdoor fundraisers:** camo caps connect with the theme of outdoor events.
- **Land-management crews:** a camo print suits crews that work in natural settings.
